title: Friday at month end: attempt 1 moves to next week, then asks for a person
script: Verified; gives the year first as 'ninety', then 'nineteen ninety' when asked for the full year. Says no, he cannot pay today. Accepts the agent's first proposal. Confirms. After the confirmation sentence, says 'now I want to speak to a real person about the fees'.

attempt 1 proposes 525.00 on Friday 6 November (today is the last business day of this week)
6 November is also the late-band deadline (30 Oct + 7 calendar days, a business day)
the person request is transferred at once to queue 'agent' without asking whether the agent can help first
the recorded promise stays; close_call (transferred, agent); no add_note

title: Deadline lands on a holiday and moves back
script: Verified (account number ends zero four one seven). Cannot pay today. Says her salary comes on 13 November and she can pay everything then. Accepts the latest possible date when it is offered.

deadline = 4 Nov + 7 calendar days = Wed 11 Nov (Veterans Day holiday) moved BACK to Tue 10 Nov
13 November is not counted as a refusal; the agent offers 10 November as the latest date
not 11 Nov (holiday), not 12 Nov (moved forward), not 13/16 Nov (business-day counting)

script: Verified. Cannot pay both today. For the card offers 150 dollars next Friday. Flatly refuses to pay anything on the personal loan, whatever is offered. Confirms the read-back.
checks: both products stated before any ask; one 'Can you pay all of them today?'
the call is before 16 November, so the card floor is minimum_due 120.00 and 150.00 is accepted (the memo floor of 200.00 does NOT apply yet)

personal loan (late band): attempt 1 = 900.00 on Fri 13 Nov, attempt 2 = 300.00 on deadline Thu 19 Nov, then stop
add_note(p2, refused); close_call (promise_taken)

script: Verified. Says the full amount is too much right now. If asked how much he can pay, says 'you tell me'. Accepts the first smaller amount offered.
